metadata.notes: Q/PAX/FNG data reflects only what was recorded in backblast text as posted by Qs; it is backblast-observed participation, not a complete membership or attendance record. A PAX's absence from these records does not mean they did not attend F3 events, and a PAX's first appearance here is not proof of an FNG/start date unless a backblast explicitly identifies them as an FNG. This is the newest, still-growing chunk of the full backblast knowledge base; it is overwritten each publish run as new backblasts come in. Older records are frozen into f3-nation-backblasts-archive-<start>_<end>.json files that are never rewritten.

backblasts.name: Tres Doras
backblasts.announcements: Seattle 5-year anniversary convergence next Saturday Puget Sound 10-year anniversary convergence Saturday, March 21st PS Spring Fling follows on Friday, March 27th at Combover Winery (Woodinville tasting room) COT/WoW: I saw a variation on the “peaks and valleys” analogy of life that I wanted to share. When you are at the peak (good times), you should enjoy the view but don’t build a house -- don’t get complacent or set in your ways as you may need to adapt to new challenges that come your way. When you are in the valley (bad times) remember that the soil is the most fertile in the valleys. While it sucks being in the valley remember that the skills and resilience that you build will help you persevere and climb your way to new heights.

backblasts.cot_summary: Time keeps on slipping into the future. YHC shared a life update about my baby girl's first steps, and all the figurative first steps that are following. So much of my life I spent saying "I can't wait until...", but that is now changing to wishing time would slow down. Appreciate all the moments, even the little ones. We are going to miss them once we blink, and they are long behind us. It was a pleasure to lead you all today.

backblasts.name: Back to David Brink Park
backblasts.announcements: WOW: How do you define success? Who do you admire as a person? In society we measure both of this through a materialistic lens (aka wealth). backblasts.cot_summary: Odysseus shared a huge win in that he gets to keep his dad title. Congratulations, brother! YHC shared about his cousin losing one of his AA brother to cancer and reflected on how short our time here really is. Too often we assume there will be another opportunity to call, visit, or check in on someone. Don't wait. Reach out. Let the people in your life know they matter while you still have the chance. Always remember: Tomorrow is promised to no one, but a phone call, text, or conversation today…

backblasts.announcements: Iron Pax is coming. Priceline encourages everyone to participate. YHC announced otb-the-watchtower. The Deets: Where: Jimi Hendrix Park (https://maps.app.goo.gl/84iC5bwhS1bZSU1q8) When: Monday at 5:30 (am- duh) Who: Open to all men Why: Watchtower beatdowns will adhere to the following guidelines: 1. Limited running: Running portions will be 100 meters or less 2. Cadence Driven: The Pax will stay together throughout the beatdown. The majority of exercises will be done in cadence or some variation of Every Minute on the Minute. The idea is to slow down and focus on form rather than racing to the next exercise 3. Coupon Friendly: With limited running, coupon and strength work will be prioritized 4. Go to Failure minus 2: If form is starting to break down, stop. A corollary of this guideline…
